10 استشكد He sought, or demanded, what is termed شُكْد [q. v.]. (L.) ―
-b2- And جَآءَ يَسْتَشْكِدُنِى He came seeking, or demanding, of me شُكْد; meaning what is given of a heap of reaped corn on the occasion of measuring, and of the bundle (حُزَم) [of corn] on the occasion of reaping: of the dial. of El-Yemen. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
